scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance in Implementation of Information and Communication Technology
other_conditions: Enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
Enterprise must commence commercial production during the scheme's operative period.
Both new manufacturing enterprises and existing ones undertaking expansion or diversification are eligible.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
benefits_summary: Up to 65% reimbursement of ICT capital expenditure, capped at ₹5,00,000 per enterprise.
